tools.title: Third-Party Verifier Toolkit
verification_commands: rch exec -- cargo build -p frankenengine-engine --bin franken-verify
tools.external_user_value: External operators can verify benchmark, replay, containment, and attestation claims without running the FrankenEngine control plane.
tools.adoption_gap: Ready for external adoption - toolkit provides standalone verification capabilities with comprehensive documentation and neutral scoring.

tools.title: Extension-Heavy Benchmark Suite v1.0
tools.external_user_value: Other runtime teams can use the benchmark suite as a neutral scoring and publication surface.
tools.adoption_gap: This tool lane remains non-adopted until outside-project users are documented through explicit benchmark-adoption evidence.

tools.title: Parser Third-Party Rerun Kit
verification_commands: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly cargo test -p frankenengine-engine --test parser_third_party_rerun_kit
tools.external_user_value: External operators can rerun parser reproducibility evidence without insider knowledge.
tools.adoption_gap: This tool lane remains non-adopted until outside-project users and their rerun outcomes are documented explicitly.
